author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನೊಳಿಹ ದುರುಳನನು ಹೊರಗೆಳೆದು ಸಂಹರಿಸು
ನಿನ್ನಜೊತೆ ಅನ್ಯರನು ಕಾಡುತಲೆ ಇಹನು
ಕನ್ನಕೊರೆಯುತಲವನು ನಿನ್ನತನ ಕದಿಯುವನು
ಸನ್ನದ್ಧನಿರು ಕಾದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Drag out the villain within you and slay him;
he keeps tormenting others along with you;
tunnelling in like a burglar, he steals your very self:
stay armed and on guard, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: There is a wrongdoer living inside each of us. Drag him out and destroy him, for he troubles not only us but those around us too. Like a thief breaking through a wall, he quietly robs us of who we are; so stay alert and keep watch.
